title: Every Last Joule — per-region snapshot
description: Schema for data/snapshots/last-good/<regionId>.json. One snapshot per region per build. See dataset/SCHEMA.md for the human-readable description.

profile.description: 30-day trailing average curtailment in GW, one value per UTC hour (index 0 = 00:00–01:00 UTC).

latestProfile.description: Single-day latest snapshot in GW per UTC hour.

lastUpdated.description: Calibration-anchor date: YYYY, YYYY-Q#, or ISO-8601.

sourceNote.description: Human-readable provenance string surfaced in the dashboard tooltip and paper Usage Notes.

sourceStatus.description: Whether the last fetch was fresh (live) or served from withFallback (cached).

fuelShare.description: Fuel-type split of the curtailed energy, fractions 0–1.

uncertaintyLowGW.description: Lower bound of the 95% interval on peakGW. Added in S2.

uncertaintyHighGW.description: Upper bound of the 95% interval on peakGW. Added in S2.

confidenceTier.description: Deterministic classification of source quality. Added in S2.
